title: Stabilizer
text: Stabilizer. This rug pad works well to stabilize rugs on bare floors.  I use it to secure my dog stairway to a bare wooden floor, and it does the trick.

product_metadata.title: Grip-It Ultra Stop Natural Rug Pad, 3x5
features: Non-Slip Rug Pad For Hardwood Floors: The Grip-It Ultra Stop Natural is an affordable, low-profile, natural rug pad specially designed to help keep area rugs in place and prevent them from slipping and sliding on hard-surface floors
Helps keep rugs in place to prevent bunching and shifting

Durable Design: Non-slip rug pad contains natural rubber, a highly effective and renewable resource with non-slip properties made without plasticizers/adhesives; Special "open weave" construction offers great coverage while maintaining air flow and helps makes vacuuming easier
Easy Care: We offer a 10-year guarantee with proper use and maintenance; Spot clean your non-slip rug gripper with water, a damp sponge and air dry

Why Grip-It: Everything we sell, including our Ultra Stop Natural non-skid rug pad, is designed with your safety and comfort in mind; Secure out-of-control rugs that could cause falls and avoid costly floor repairs with the help of Grip-It
description: MSM Industries' Grip-It non slip area rug pads help keep rugs in place, prevent bunching and sliding, protect floor surfaces and provide extra cushion and comfort. With over 25 years of rug pad manufacturing experience, MSM Industries offers 15 styles of Grip-It rug pads to meet a wide variety of size and application requirements on hard surface or carpeted floors. All rug pads are easily trimmed to fit for custom sized area rugs and come with a 10 year guarantee to maintain non-slip properties with proper maintenance. Rug pads should only be used on clean, dry, and a fully cured floors. Do not use on lacquered, acrylic or porous surfaces. Please follow the flooring manufacturer's pad type recommendation. Damage to the finish could occur.
